SLOT_NETWORK.description: Inspect transaction channel, merchant POS terminal geography, transit velocity, payment gateway routing, and acquiring bank clearing paths.

SLOT_DEVICE.description: Evaluate EMV cryptographic chip status, magstripe fallback indicators, terminal entry modes (PAN keyed vs chip vs contactless), PIN errors, and physical card integrity.

SLOT_BEHAVIOR.description: Analyze transaction cadence velocity, purchase amount deviation from historical median, and consecutive authorization error frequency.

SLOT_GRAPH.description: Traverse merchant category codes (MCC), card issuer BIN clusters, and compromised merchant point-of-compromise (CPP) breach trees.

TYPE_CREDIT_CARD_FRAUD.description: Detects unauthorized credit card transactions, counterfeit magnetic stripe exploitation, and high-velocity purchasing fraud across merchant acquirers and payment processors.

hypotheses.title: Automated Card Testing Botnet
hypotheses.text: Automated card testing botnet executing high-velocity micro-charge authorization probes across merchant payment gateways to validate stolen card batches.

falsification_criteria.description: A normal consumer transaction cadence of 2 or fewer purchases per hour reflects standard retail behavior, decisively refuting high-frequency automated card testing bot scripts.
Zero authorization declines or CVV/expiration verification errors decisively refutes automated credential and PIN guessing attempts.

hypotheses.title: Syndicated Carding Ring
hypotheses.text: Organized carding syndicate utilizing cloned physical magstripes, compromised issuer BIN batches, or coordinated mule networks to liquidate stolen credit lines.

falsification_criteria.description: Zero statistical correlation across payment card Bank Identification Numbers (BINs) and associated account clusters decisively refutes syndicated carding rings exploiting compromised card batches.
Cryptographically verified EMV chip and PIN handshakes without fallback anomalies refute physical counterfeit magnetic stripe cards used by organized fraud syndicates.

hypotheses.title: Legitimate Cardholder Travel or Expense
hypotheses.text: Legitimate cardholder traveling for leisure, authorized family member purchasing household supplies, or routine corporate business expense settlement.

falsification_criteria.description: Supersonic geographical transit velocity between successive card swipes violates commercial air travel limits, decisively refuting legitimate cardholder travel.
A localized merchant chargeback rate exceeding 20% indicates concentrated fraudulent settlement, decisively refuting legitimate routine consumer shopping purchases.

hypotheses.title: Novel Settlement Exploit
hypotheses.text: Uncataloged payment gateway race condition, novel merchant settlement arbitrage, or zero-day token manipulation exploit bypassing authorization controls.

TYPE_CARD_PRESENT_COUNTERFEIT.description: Investigates in-person Point-of-Sale (POS) fraud involving skimmed track data, cloned magnetic stripes, and fraudulent electronic fallback from EMV chip terminals.

hypotheses.title: Programmatic POS Injector Device
hypotheses.text: Automated hardware tap device programmatically injecting cloned track data into unattended retail POS terminals at high transaction velocity.

falsification_criteria.description: Organic manual transaction cadence of 2 or fewer swipes per hour matches natural consumer retail checkout pacing, decisively refuting automated hardware tap injection devices.
Authentic physical card EMV cryptographic certificate validation and Application Cryptogram (ARQC) generation refute magnetic stripe skimming copies.

hypotheses.title: Syndicated POS Skimming Ring
hypotheses.text: Coordinated fraud syndicate systematically presenting cloned counterfeit physical cards across multiple retail store chains using recruited runner crews.

falsification_criteria.description: An isolated payment card entity with zero cloned card syndicate linkages or runner crew connections decisively refutes organized retail skimming operations.
Zero correlation across compromised merchant POS terminals and linked skimming rings decisively refutes syndicated card distribution networks.

hypotheses.title: Legitimate Magnetic Swipe Fallback
hypotheses.text: Authentic consumer experiencing damaged EMV terminal contact pins resulting in authorized point-of-sale magnetic stripe swipe fallback.

falsification_criteria.description: Calculated geographical transit velocity exceeding 900 km/h between terminal swipes decisively refutes legitimate physical cardholder fallback.
An extreme merchant chargeback rate exceeding 15% confirms systematic terminal fraud, decisively refuting authentic hardware terminal chip reader malfunction.

hypotheses.title: Novel EMV Protocol Tampering
hypotheses.text: Uncataloged chip-and-pin cryptographic downgrade or novel dynamic data authentication bypass vulnerability compromising terminal integrity.

TYPE_CARD_NOT_PRESENT_ECOM.description: Monitors Card-Not-Present (CNP) e-commerce transactions executed using compromised cardholder credentials, account takeover, or intercepted virtual card numbers across online checkouts.

hypotheses.title: Automated E-Commerce Carding Bot
hypotheses.text: Automated headless carding bot rotating proxy networks to systematically validate stolen credit card numbers across online checkout forms.

falsification_criteria.description: Low organic transaction velocity of 2 or fewer orders per hour indicates deliberate consumer checkout deliberation, decisively refuting programmatic e-commerce card stuffing botnets.
Commercial hosting datacenter egress confirms automated e-commerce checkout script runners, decisively refuting genuine consumer residential internet browsing.

hypotheses.title: Distributed Online Carding Syndicate
hypotheses.text: Organized ring utilizing purchased dark web credential batches to place fraudulent e-commerce orders shipped to recruited reshipping mules.

falsification_criteria.description: Zero shared reshipping addresses, zero shared payout wallets, and zero linked syndicate mule accounts decisively refute coordinated e-commerce carding rings.
Authentic customer device profile and stable hardware cryptographic identity refute rotating virtualized anti-detect browser clusters deployed by carding syndicates.

hypotheses.title: Legitimate Online Guest Checkout
hypotheses.text: Legitimate consumer ordering online without stored payment profile using domestic residential Internet service or corporate enterprise proxy.

falsification_criteria.description: Repeated card verification failure rate exceeding 85% indicates hostile credential guessing, decisively refuting authentic customer online guest checkout.
An extreme localized payment chargeback spike exceeding 20% confirms fraudulent order origination, decisively refuting legitimate consumer e-commerce orders.

hypotheses.title: Novel 3D-Secure Protocol Bypass
hypotheses.text: Uncataloged payment gateway token substitution or novel 3D-Secure authentication handshake race condition intercepting verification codes.

TYPE_GEO_VELOCITY_IMPOSSIBLE_TRAVEL.description: Analyzes successive card transaction events exhibiting impossible geographical transit velocities between physical locations, indicating credential cloning or multi-party unauthorized plastic sharing.

hypotheses.title: Automated Distributed Multi-Geo Bot
hypotheses.text: Automated card tester concurrently triggering payment authorizations across distant geographic servers to probe multi-currency merchant accounts.

falsification_criteria.description: Deliberate human transaction pacing of 2 or fewer transactions per hour decisively refutes multi-geo automated authorization scripts.
Cloud hosting provider ASN confirms automated distributed proxy authorization pipelines, refuting authentic physical cardholder presence.

hypotheses.title: Distributed Counterfeit Carding Cell
hypotheses.text: Multi-city carding syndicate presenting cloned physical card plastics at disparate retail locations simultaneously to outpace fraud alerts.

falsification_criteria.description: A completely isolated card entity with zero cross-city carding ring correlations decisively refutes multi-city syndicated carding cells.
Authentic cryptographic EMV chip validation without magnetic fallback refutes duplicated counterfeit physical cards distributed across multiple locations.

hypotheses.title: Authorized Joint Account Holders
hypotheses.text: Legitimate spouses or business partners concurrently transacting in separate cities using authorized secondary cards linked to account.

falsification_criteria.description: Extreme velocity exceeding supersonic commercial aviation speeds (>= 2500 km/h) decisively refutes legitimate joint account travel or family card sharing.
A high payment dispute spike exceeding 20% confirms unauthorized card exploitation, decisively refuting authentic authorized secondary cardholder purchasing.

hypotheses.title: Novel Settlement Geo-Spoofing
hypotheses.text: Uncataloged merchant acquirer terminal spoofing or novel payment processor timezone desynchronization exploit altering physical transaction coordinates.

TYPE_RAPID_VELOCITY_CASH_OUT.description: Identifies rapid consecutive transactions designed to drain card credit lines or merchant gift card balances prior to cardholder fraud alert notification or bank account freezing.

hypotheses.title: High-Frequency Liquidation Bot
hypotheses.text: Automated checkout script rapidly executing consecutive high-value transactions within seconds to maximize stolen credit limit extraction.

falsification_criteria.description: Organic customer purchasing cadence of 2 or fewer purchases per hour decisively refutes high-frequency automated liquidation scripts.
Commercial cloud hosting infrastructure confirms programmatic automated liquidation pipelines, refuting legitimate consumer in-store or mobile transactions.

hypotheses.title: Coordinated Cash-Out Crew
hypotheses.text: Syndicated fraud team rapidly purchasing high-value electronics and gift cards across multiple physical merchant stores in parallel.

falsification_criteria.description: A single isolated card record with zero correlation to known cash-out crews decisively refutes syndicated physical liquidation operations.
Zero correlation across compromised credit card BIN trees and liquidation accounts decisively refutes coordinated cash-out crews.

hypotheses.title: Legitimate High-Volume Holiday Shopping
hypotheses.text: Genuine consumer executing rapid consecutive purchases during major holiday discount events, home relocation, or emergency medical expenditures.

falsification_criteria.description: An abnormal chargeback rate spike exceeding 20% confirms systematic fraudulent extraction, decisively refuting legitimate consumer holiday shopping bursts.
A high payment authorization failure rate exceeding 80% indicates stolen card guessing, decisively refuting authentic verified consumer purchasing.

hypotheses.title: Novel Settlement Race Condition
hypotheses.text: Uncataloged multi-gateway authorization race condition or novel real-time balance exhaustion loophole overdrawing credit accounts.

TYPE_MERCHANT_COLLUSION_DISPUTE.description: Detects friendly fraud dispute abuse, fraudulent chargebacks, and collusive merchant terminal operations engineered to siphon funds through synthetic refund arbitration.

hypotheses.title: Automated Dispute Filing Script
hypotheses.text: Automated bot mass-generating chargeback dispute requests using scraped transaction metadata to exploit merchant refund arbitration windows.

falsification_criteria.description: Normal single transaction claim pacing of 2 or fewer dispute submissions per hour decisively refutes automated mass dispute generation scripts.
Commercial datacenter IP allocation confirms programmatic botnet claim submission pipelines, refuting authentic consumer dispute filings.

hypotheses.title: Collusive Merchant-Buyer Ring
hypotheses.text: Organized syndicate colluding with merchant accounts to execute fraudulent purchases followed by systematic structured non-delivery dispute claims.

falsification_criteria.description: Zero correlation across disputed transaction cards and merchant ownership entities decisively refutes organized merchant-buyer collusion syndicates.
An isolated buyer entity with zero syndicated dispute ring network linkages decisively refutes coordinated chargeback abuse rings.

hypotheses.title: Authentic Logistics Delivery Failure
hypotheses.text: Genuine consumer experiencing authentic carrier shipping failure, damaged parcel delivery, or merchant billing administrative error.

falsification_criteria.description: An extreme localized chargeback spike exceeding 25% on the merchant account refutes isolated genuine postal carrier transit failures.
Supersonic travel velocity exceeding 900 km/h between dispute filing and physical delivery coordinates refutes authentic local consumer merchant logistics disputes.

hypotheses.title: Novel Dispute Arbitrage Exploit
hypotheses.text: Uncataloged card network dispute rules arbitrage or novel multi-currency settlement loophole evading merchant representment defenses.

TYPE_HIGH_RISK_MCC_STRUCTURING.description: Investigates transaction structuring, money mule routing, and capital dispersion across high-risk merchant categories (casinos, cryptocurrency exchanges, wire transfers, and luxury goods).

hypotheses.title: Automated Micro-Structuring Bot
hypotheses.text: Automated structuring bot dispersing capital through programmatic micro-charges below regulatory reporting thresholds across gambling and crypto merchants.

falsification_criteria.description: A single isolated purchase of 2 or fewer transactions per hour decisively refutes automated programmatic micro-charge structuring scripts.
Hosting provider ASN confirms programmatic automated payment structuring pipelines, refuting genuine consumer retail transactions.

hypotheses.title: Coordinated Mule Liquidation Ring
hypotheses.text: Syndicated network of recruited mule cardholders laundering illicit funds through high-risk jewelry, casino, or cryptocurrency liquidation points.

falsification_criteria.description: A completely isolated account node with zero circular transaction or mule network links decisively refutes coordinated mule liquidation rings.
Zero shared financial instruments, payout wallets, or multi-account referral graphs decisively refute syndicated money laundering cartels.

hypotheses.title: Legitimate Personal Leisure Expenditure
hypotheses.text: Legitimate consumer occasionally purchasing licensed gaming entertainment, official state lottery tickets, or personal luxury jewelry gifts.

falsification_criteria.description: An extreme authorization rejection rate exceeding 80% confirms card validation probing, decisively refuting genuine verified consumer entertainment purchases.
An abnormal merchant chargeback rate exceeding 20% confirms fraudulent liquidation, decisively refuting legitimate personal leisure expenditures.

hypotheses.title: Novel Financial Layering Protocol
hypotheses.text: Uncataloged decentralized payment gateway mixing or novel cross-border currency structuring technique evading AML detection models.

TASK_RISK_INVESTIGATION.description: Universal risk investigation root channel for financial transaction fraud, credit line protection, and merchant settlement integrity analysis.

hypotheses.title: Automated Velocity Card Testing
hypotheses.text: Automated card testing bot executing high-velocity sequential transactions across merchant payment gateways to test authorization validity.

falsification_criteria.description: Normal consumer transaction pacing of 2 or fewer charges per hour decisively refutes automated high-frequency card testing scripts.
Clean authorization without PIN or CVV errors decisively refutes automated credential guessing bots.

hypotheses.title: Coordinated Carding Syndicate
hypotheses.text: Coordinated fraud syndicate operating cloned physical card profiles and distributed mule networks across multiple merchant locations.

falsification_criteria.description: An isolated card entity with zero linked carding syndicate connections decisively refutes organized carding syndicates.
Cryptographically verified EMV chip transactions with valid cryptograms refute cloned physical counterfeit magnetic stripes.

hypotheses.title: Legitimate Cardholder Travel
hypotheses.text: Legitimate cardholder traveling, authorized family member purchasing, or regular commercial subscription renewal on personal accounts.

falsification_criteria.description: Calculated transit speed exceeding 900 km/h between transactions violates physical movement feasibility, decisively refuting legitimate cardholder travel.
A localized merchant chargeback spike exceeding 20% confirms fraudulent merchant exposure, decisively refuting legitimate consumer shopping.

hypotheses.title: Uncataloged Payment Exploit
hypotheses.text: Uncataloged point-of-sale firmware exploit, novel settlement race condition, or zero-day token manipulation bypassing authorization controls.
